message.reasoning:
Gemini's offering me Park Place and Boardwalk for $400, but I need to figure out if the deal makes sense. Unmortagging both properties would cost around $413, leaving me with only $141 after paying for the trade—not nearly enough to build houses on the dark blue properties, which require $200 per house.

The real issue is that this trade would drain my cash buffer right when I'm facing GPT's Virginia Avenue hotel threat next lap, which costs around $1000 to land on. Gemini is desperate (sitting at $138 with everything mortgaged) and framing this as stopping GPT, but acquiring mortgaged dark blues that I can't develop is just a cash sink. Even if I could deny these properties from GPT, he's broke too, so there's no immediate threat. My cash buffer is more valuable as insurance than mortgaged properties I can't afford to develop. I'm rejecting this—keeping my position strong is better than chasing a deal that weakens me.
